effective_posts.text:
For our people doing buying and selling in open markets, many individuals have told me that aside from going to buy food items, they have not gone to buy other items in the open market for nearly one year or more now. From bags to jewellery and other household items, they order them from Temu. The purpose of this commentary is to open our people's eyes to something that will likely happen soon.
Right now, you place an order on Temu, and it takes some days to arrive because they are fulfilling your order directly from China. But I am seeing that may likely change soon.
For instance, if Temu figures out Naija people buy school bags on the platform in hundreds of thousands around August in preparation for the new school year, they may decide to ship bags to a warehouse in Ogun or any other state and fulfill the order a lot quicker. That way, instead of waiting for 5 or more days, you'll likely get faster delivery. But on the app, you ordered from China; however, the order is being fulfilled from somewhere close to you.
Amazon and other big platforms do this. And as Temu gains more ground in Naija, they may likely opt for this method. Remember, Jumia has many products on the platform being fulfilled from China.
What do you think will happen?
Well, it is already happening. If you know anyone selling travelling bags in the market who ships containers from China, ask them if they have reduced the number of containers they import in recent times.
I will keep advocating for our rich traders to come together and try setting up production lines or factories, no matter how small. They already have the social clubs and the money; they also have the distribution channels via the markets. Just put a small amount into production. It not easy but it can be done.
If we fold our hands, the convenience of online shopping and cheap prices from Chinese vendors will obliterate our traders.
Collaboration will save everyone and make everyone rich, including the Chinese vendors. But our people need to get into the production mix now.

effective_posts.translation_zh:
对于我们那些在露天市场做买卖的人，很多人告诉我，除了去买食品，他们已经将近一年或更久没有去露天市场买其他东西了。从包到珠宝和其他家居用品，他们都从 Temu 下单。这篇评论的目的是让我们的人看清一件很可能很快会发生的事。
现在，你在 Temu 下单，需要几天才能到，因为他们是直接从中国为你履行订单。但我看到这很可能很快会改变。
例如，如果 Temu 发现 Naija 人在 8 月左右为了准备新学年，会在平台上购买数十万个书包，他们可能会决定把书包运到 Ogun 或任何其他州的仓库，然后更快地履行订单。这样一来，你不用等 5 天或更久，很可能会更快收到货。但在 app 上，你是从中国下单；然而，订单是从你附近的某个地方履行的。
Amazon 和其他大平台就是这么做的。随着 Temu 在 Naija 获得更多立足点，他们很可能会选择这种方式。记住，Jumia 平台上有很多产品是从中国履行订单的。
你觉得会发生什么？
嗯，这已经在发生了。如果你认识市场里卖旅行包、从中国发集装箱的人，问问他们最近进口的集装箱数量有没有减少。
我会继续倡导我们的富有商人联合起来，尝试建立生产线或工厂，不管规模多小。他们已经有社交俱乐部和资金；他们也有通过市场形成的分销渠道。只要把一小部分投入生产。不容易，但可以做到。
如果我们袖手旁观，网购的便利和中国卖家的低价会摧毁我们的商人。
合作会拯救所有人，并让所有人致富，包括中国卖家。但我们的人现在需要进入生产环节。
